title: Qlik App Usage and Adoption
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), reload task history, section access audit, Qlik Cloud events (`com.qlik.v1.*`) and app/reload metrics via REST.
app: Qlik Sense Enterprise logs (Scheduler/Engine/Proxy/Repository) via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Cloud events via the Qlik Cloud REST API through HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:proxy activity=app_open
| stats count as opens, dc(user) as unique_users, latest(_time) as last_open by app_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_open)/86400,0)
| sort - opens
description: Ranks Qlik apps by open count and unique users and flags stale apps, informing rationalisation and RAM savings.
value: Unused Qlik apps still consume memory and reload capacity; adoption data guides cleanup and capacity planning.
implementation: Ingest proxy session logs; schedule weekly; share low-usage lists with owners.
visualization: Bar chart of top apps, table of stale apps.
grandmaExplanation: We show which Qlik apps people really use so you can retire the ones nobody opens and free up resources.
